summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake of Pylaemenes the Paphlagonian, ally of Troy in the Iliad.

story.text: Apollodorus names Pylaemenes among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Eurypylus and before Acamas in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
